scope: Driver registry and base-driver exception reporting

behavior.registry_result: Driver health-check/load failures return the exception class without provider, import, or database message text.
behavior.registry_logs: Driver registry lifecycle and dynamic-import failures log bounded exception classes without traceback or exception messages.
behavior.base_driver: BaseDriver.run logs only the exception class and still re-raises the original exception for existing caller handling.

coverage: driver test results omit exception details
dynamic-import error logs omit exception details
BaseDriver.run logs omit exception details while preserving the original raised exception

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; mocked exceptions and registry connections only

limitations: No configured driver, live provider, or database was used.
This does not establish driver provider availability or live ingestion parity.
